newsitem.title: USA: Health and Retirement sells 23.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Health and Retirement sells 23.5 mln shares.

text.p: Health and Retirement Properties Trust said Friday it has sold 23.5 million common shares in an underwritten public offering. The gross offering price was $18.875 per share.

The company said it expects to use the proceeds from the offering to repay debt and to purchase a portfolio of 30 office properties totaling 3.4 million square feet that are leased to the U.S. Government.
In addition to the 23.5 million shares being offered, the company said it has granted the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 3,525,000 shares at the same price.
The offering was led by Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp.
